4.8 stars. 3,428 reviews. At a seafood spot most tourists never find.

Ann Seafood sits right on Bãi Khem, one of Phu Quoc's clearest stretches of water. Fresh catch. Proper portions. The kind of place locals bring their families on weekends.

If you're staying south side, this is your dinner plan. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
